title: Parkio Daily for July 25, 2026
teaser: Haunted Mansion loses its hanging corpse after 55 years; Disneyland holiday season starts earlier than planned; new Halloween party menus debut.

rides.name: Test Track
rides.note: Early Entry windows often clear by mid-morning

breaking.title: Haunted Mansion loses hanging corpse effect after 55 years
breaking.body: Magic Kingdom removed the hanging body from the Stretching Room finale at Haunted Mansion. The figure previously appeared in the lightning flash before guests exit the chamber.

parkioInsight.text: The Stretching Room finale now plays differently than longtime fans remember. If the effect was a must-see for your group, manage expectations before entering the queue.

breaking.title: Disneyland starts 2026 holiday season earlier than announced
breaking.body: Disneyland Resort moved its Christmas season start forward by several days from the originally published November date. Decorations, seasonal food, and entertainment will now begin sooner.

parkioInsight.text: Early November visits now overlap with holiday decor installation. Crowds tend to spike once full holiday entertainment launches, so booking the first few days may offer shorter waits and photo ops with partial theming.

bignews.title: Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party menus released for 2026
bignews.body: Magic Kingdom revealed exclusive snacks, entrees, and desserts for the after-hours Halloween event running August 7 through October 31. New items include themed treats available only during party nights.

parkioInsight.text: Party-exclusive food often sells out by mid-evening on busy nights. Arriving at rope drop for the event and hitting food carts before 8pm usually locks in popular items before stock runs low.

bignews.title: Columbia store reopens at Disney Springs with refreshed look
bignews.body: The outdoor apparel retailer returned to Disney Springs after a refurbishment. The store now features updated fixtures and layout.

parkioInsight.text: Reopening days typically bring promotional pricing or launch inventory. Stopping by Columbia early in the weekend often nets first pick of restocked gear before sizes thin out.

bignews.title: Tropical Americas construction removes Carousel of Progress and Dinosaur Treasures roofing
bignews.body: Animal Kingdom's expansion work stripped the roofing from former gift shop structures inside the Tropical Americas site. The area remains walled off as demolition and vertical construction continue.

parkioInsight.text: Heavy equipment noise tends to spike near DinoLand pathways mid-morning through early afternoon. Scheduling sit-down meals or heading to Pandora during those hours usually offers quieter breaks.

bignews.title: Pandora jewelry store unveils coral pink facade at Downtown Disney
bignews.body: The Downtown Disney District Pandora location finished its exterior refresh, replacing the white marquee with a coral pink design and new signage. Construction walls came down this week.

parkioInsight.text: Fresh storefronts often stock limited-edition charms or run soft-launch promos. Visiting Pandora before mid-afternoon today may surface inventory not yet on shelves at other locations.

topstories.title: Journey Into Imagination Lightning Lane passes selling out daily
topstories.body: The 40-year-old EPCOT attraction is reaching daily Lightning Lane inventory limits, a pattern not seen in previous summers. Standby waits remain modest but paid skip-the-line slots disappear by late morning.

parkioInsight.text: Standby lines for Imagination rarely exceed 15 minutes before noon. Walking on during Early Entry or right at park open usually beats paying for a Lightning Lane that may sell out anyway.

topstories.title: Construction walls appear outside Crystal Palace in Magic Kingdom
topstories.body: New barriers went up around portions of the Crystal Palace exterior. The restaurant remains open for table service meals, but scaffolding suggests facade or roof work ahead.

parkioInsight.text: Exterior work can muffle the character breakfast atmosphere and block window views. Guests prioritizing photo ops with Pooh and friends may prefer waiting until the project wraps or booking a different character meal.

topstories.title: New plant-based loaded baked potato debuts at EPCOT
topstories.body: A vegan baked potato topped with plant-based toppings arrived at an EPCOT quick-service location for 14 dollars. Early reviews highlight portion size and flavor balance.

parkioInsight.text: Plant-based menu launches often draw curious crowds in the first week. Ordering before 12:30pm or after 2pm typically shortens counter waits and ensures toppings stay fully stocked.

topstories.title: Port Orleans French Quarter adds new resort merchandise collection
topstories.body: The moderate resort rolled out apparel, pins, glassware, and candles themed to the property's Mardi Gras aesthetic. Items are available at Jackson Square Gifts and Desires.

parkioInsight.text: Resort-specific collections tend to sell through quickly, especially on weekends. Guests staying at French Quarter or taking a Sassagoula River Cruise can often grab merchandise before park-goers arrive via bus.

topstories.title: Star Tours hoodie and First Order pins arrive at Hollywood Studios
topstories.body: New Star Wars apparel and collectibles landed at merchandise locations, including a blue Star Tours hoodie, Admiral Ackbar tee, and Empire-themed pin sets.

parkioInsight.text: Star Wars merchandise drops often concentrate at Tatooine Traders near Star Tours. Visiting that shop first thing during Early Entry usually offers the widest size and design selection.

topstories.title: Loungefly releases woven backpack and character coin purses
topstories.body: A brown woven Loungefly backpack priced at 80 dollars and Stitch-themed coin purses appeared at Walt Disney World locations including Disney Springs and Animal Kingdom. The collection uses basket-weave styling.

parkioInsight.text: Loungefly drops can vanish within 48 hours at high-traffic shops. Disney Springs stores like Disney Ever After tend to restock overnight, so mornings often yield better inventory than evenings.

icymi.title: Disney Parks guest satisfaction scores climb 15 to 20 percent
icymi.body: Walt Disney World reported higher guest approval ratings tied to recent resort room reimaginings and attraction refurbishments. The company cited reinvestment in aging infrastructure as a driver of improved scores.

icymi.title: Universal Orlando confirms softening summer attendance
icymi.body: Comcast's quarterly report acknowledged weaker theme park crowds this summer at Universal Orlando. The company noted the pattern continues into the current quarter despite Epic Universe construction progress.

icymi.title: Character meet-and-greet guide published for Animal Kingdom
icymi.body: Disney's official blog released a detailed walkthrough of every character greeting location at Animal Kingdom, including schedules and photo tips for meets with Mickey, Donald, and others.

icymi.title: Light-up princess hair bows featuring Rapunzel and Tiana now on sale
icymi.body: Disney World added battery-powered hair bows with Rapunzel and Tiana portraits to accessory shops. The bows clip into hair and retail for 19.99 dollars each.

spotlight.title: Test Track Early Entry success even with delayed arrival
spotlight.body: A recent trip report showed guests arriving 20 minutes after Early Entry began still completed both Test Track and Guardians of the Galaxy before regular rope drop crowds hit. EPCOT's morning window remains forgiving for resort guests willing to hustle between Future World attractions.

parkioInsight.text: EPCOT Early Entry tends to stay productive until 8:50am even if you miss the 8:30 start. Prioritizing Test Track first, then walking to Guardians, often locks in two headliners before standby lines balloon past 45 minutes.
